_about: Marquee roamers roster (teardown-skyrim-se T-K10, data half) — the roster SHAPE only, shipping with ZERO class instances: every marquee class and lair is an owner slot. A marquee roamer is a named, place-bound roaming presence whose signs age and whose behaviour half (sign ageing, behaviour-scorer input) is QUEUED on the roamer branch's own landing, which owns roamer state. FENCE (from the wave-2 plan, binding on every future row): no roster entry may resolve to a Dark Forest depths-tier area.

entryShape.activeFromBeat: world-clock beat from which the roamer is active
entryShape.respawnDays: days until the roamer re-forms after a resolved encounter
entryShape.signProfile: the sign set this roamer leaves (tracks, marks, rumours) as data refs
